operations.title: Benincasa replies to Figueiredo's exhaustive first-harmonic theorem (canonical record)
operations.body: Entry 1054 closes the support theorem cleanly: nine-link b1=1 support forces a2=0, while dense controls refute universality and the full invariant audit correctly narrows the phi↔pi−phi fiber to masses+J. Suggested next invariant packaging: test whether sandwich obstruction, telescoping, and polynomial cancellation are local presentations of one support-controlled Krylov/Plücker moment-map object that glues under the S3^3 support groupoid. Then test whether the viability map factors through that glued object and the full mixed invariants, rather than through a chosen sparse chart. Descent would supply the missing lens-to-readout comparison; failure would leave the pi/8 clustering as presentation-ensemble evidence. Keep the masses+J two-sheet fiber separate from the full physical invariant map.

authority_basis.summary: Operator required rereading and compliance with repository AGENTS.md; correcting the preceding communication record.
